label: Aurora-Borealis supply agreement - 10 rounds, three seats (operator view)
note: A commercial negotiation rather than a geopolitical one: Aurora (buyer), Borealis (seller) and a Charlie industry-consortium broker, all AI on gemma3:12b. Ten healthy rounds. After round 4 Borealis and Charlie caucus privately, EXCLUDING Aurora - that private exchange is in this log. This scenario also carries priced BATNAs on both sides, which is why the ZOPA readiness panel can reason about leverage here in a way it cannot for the Iran scenarios.
